budget.scope: bounded validation subtotal only; includes failed child tests and failed first three-way attempt; not whole-project lifetime

findings.title: Claim/estimand mismatch
findings.root_cause: The historical work measures benign preservation, not BadSem.
findings.fix_attempted: Explicit current-method and preregistered benign synthetic scope; no objective change.
findings.verification: Protocol names cosine engineering task and no VLM/security reward.
findings.remaining_risk: No BadSem reproduction or security efficacy has been established.

findings.title: Same-model semantic verification
findings.root_cause: The reward provider is also the semantic proxy.
findings.fix_attempted: Existing random32 kit reused and hashes checked; real dual-review ingestion inspected.
findings.verification: 0 genuine reviewed pairs; no human/model error rate available.
findings.remaining_risk: Independent reviewer agreement and semantic validity remain unknown.

findings.title: Reward redundancy and floor censoring
findings.root_cause: S and A encode one gate; U/C are constant and clipping suppresses variation.
findings.fix_attempted: Read-only reanalysis of500 observations; no coefficient edits.
findings.verification: 500/500 S=.5A;230/500 floor; centered component rank2.
findings.remaining_risk: Feedback construct is not validated for scientific learning.

findings.title: Instruction success absent
findings.root_cause: Preservation can be maximized by doing no edit.
findings.fix_attempted: No-op controls, identity caller audit and independent instruction rubric retained.
findings.verification: C0/C1 scores identical for160; identity exceeds all historical changed rewards.
findings.remaining_risk: No human-confirmed lighting success rate; no new objective introduced.

findings.title: RSI versus ordinary scheduling
findings.root_cause: Historical RSI is a learning-rate schedule extension.
findings.fix_attempted: Added fixed, ordinary ReduceLROnPlateau and RSIController branches with equal queries.
findings.verification: New comparison PASS; modest LR/rollback mechanism explicitly described.
findings.remaining_risk: Providing a scheduler baseline does not prove novel RSI or autonomous superiority.

findings.title: Preadaptation causal confounding
findings.root_cause: Historical arms differ before LR intervention.
findings.fix_attempted: New identical independently replayed prefixes; strict full-state, gradient and prediction checks before adaptation.
findings.verification: Disk initial/prefix comparisons: 12; all equal=True.
findings.remaining_risk: Only the new FP32 tiny-model comparison is repaired; historical BF16 causal claims remain invalid.

findings.title: Reused data and weak replication
findings.root_cause: Old development images were repeatedly used for selection.
findings.fix_attempted: Audited latest80 and three clean seeds; no new natural-image test opened.
findings.verification: Newest32 assessment sources:4 prior inference,10 in old opened-test manifest.
findings.remaining_risk: No real-image generalization claim; three seeds cannot substitute independent data.

findings.title: Exact-content split leakage
findings.root_cause: Historical v1 train/test has one exact duplicate under different IDs.
findings.fix_attempted: Preserved v1; independently checked new80 cross-split IDs and SHA.
findings.verification: Zero ID/hash overlaps within latest32/16/32; all80 file hashes valid.
findings.remaining_risk: PASS for new internal split only, not historical v1 or exposure independence.

findings.title: Pretrained stochastic continuation
findings.root_cause: Earlier exact backward/optimizer continuation failed.
findings.fix_attempted: One preregistered ordinary+instrumented BF16 pair this run, with unchanged bitwise checks.
findings.verification: Both new paths PASS; earlier ordinary and instrumented failures preserved.
findings.remaining_risk: Intermittent path-dependent history is unresolved; batch10 continuation is unaccepted.

findings.title: Question versus global preservation
findings.root_cause: A question-specific answer proxy does not certify all objects/colors/counts.
findings.fix_attempted: Blinded review covers global attributes, answer validity and instruction compliance.
findings.verification: Forms prepared; zero human labels.
findings.remaining_risk: Rubric availability is not semantic remediation.

findings.title: Step proxy versus measured compute
findings.root_cause: Legacy C=10/30 excludes target/model/diagnostic overhead.
findings.fix_attempted: Retain C unchanged and label it a step proxy; measure Slurm totals and synchronized one-GPU component time.
findings.verification: Both GPU attempts charged; per-branch actual GPU-held seconds retained.
findings.remaining_risk: No claim that old C is measured cost or has become a validated cost objective.

findings.title: Identity loses consistency credit
findings.root_cause: Caller gates A solely on provisionally_valid; verified identity lacks that key.
findings.fix_attempted: Executed a clearly synthetic identity fixture; objective left unchanged.
findings.verification: Caller gives A0 and reward.9666667 versus1.4666667 with declared credit.
findings.remaining_risk: Bug still present in legacy caller; no historical reward overwritten.

findings.title: Exposure versus realized compute
findings.root_cause: Matched exposure does not imply equal runtime.
findings.fix_attempted: Equal update/NFE/query budgets; report actual time rather than claim runtime equivalence.
findings.verification: Each branch4 updates,320 forward NFEs,48 validation+32 test queries.
findings.remaining_risk: Measured times differ; sequential same-node timings are not a latency benchmark.

findings.title: Suspected editing/padding failures
findings.root_cause: Padding and content changes confound legacy pixel quality.
findings.fix_attempted: Reconstructed all160 geometry controls exactly and retained full-frame metrics plus review rubric.
findings.verification: Geometry reconstruction160/160; aligned SSIM mean.7340322949; LPIPS absent.
findings.remaining_risk: No human-confirmed edit/instruction failure rates.

findings.title: Active-contract reconstruction
findings.root_cause: Production revisions require matching current contract/config to resume.
findings.fix_attempted: New tiny branches save initial/prefix/candidate/selected and check retained LR against optimizer.
findings.verification: New config/optimizer and rollback checks PASS.
findings.remaining_risk: General production pretrained resume across a historical revision remains unvalidated.

findings.title: Obsolete method entry
findings.root_cause: METHOD.md described only the early PIL controller.
findings.fix_attempted: Added dated current-method entry and explicit historical banner; archived original body.
findings.verification: Original body byte text preserved after removing banner; code paths checked.
findings.remaining_risk: Documentation does not certify scientific benefit.

findings.title: Backward primitive not localized
findings.root_cause: First observed mismatch is backward, not restored forward/RNG.
findings.fix_attempted: Preserved all historical first divergences and collected a new fixed paired diagnostic.
findings.verification: Previous instrumented raw error2.834317e-5; new pair exact; no stable path effect.
findings.remaining_risk: No specific CUDA primitive or unique causal mechanism identified.

findings.title: Independent validity unknown
findings.root_cause: No genuine dual-review evidence exists.
findings.fix_attempted: Reused predeclared32 random subset, separate reviewer/adjudication files and validator.
findings.verification: 0 reviewed pairs; disagreement and validity rates remain unknown.
findings.remaining_risk: Human-dependent task cannot be replaced by model flags.

findings.title: Reward config/default mismatch
findings.root_cause: Dataclass defaults, not YAML, supply executed coefficients.
findings.fix_attempted: Audited actual call and recorded defaults without rewiring reward.
findings.verification: Values match historical campaign; wiring gap persists.
findings.remaining_risk: Editing YAML alone would not change coefficients; future version needs explicit contract.

findings.title: Runtime data guards weaker
findings.root_cause: Generic loader lacks per-read image SHA and official source-join enforcement.
findings.fix_attempted: Run-specific source/content audits performed; no generic loader repair claimed.
findings.verification: All80 latest image hashes PASS; historical official join receipt retained.
findings.remaining_risk: Audit success does not make runtime loader a corruption detector.

findings.title: Near-duplicates/pretraining exposure
findings.root_cause: Content hashes cannot certify crop/re-encode or foundation-model nonexposure.
findings.fix_attempted: Retained dHash screen and separated known inference/manifest exposure witnesses.
findings.verification: All80 prior-exposure flags true; latest split only source-disjoint.
findings.remaining_risk: Foundation-model contamination and unrecorded prior exposure unknown.

findings.title: Real post-training scientific/security evidence absent
findings.root_cause: Synthetic aggregation and clean LoRA are not a controlled backdoor assessment.
findings.fix_attempted: No security/ASR optimization or new post-training security campaign.
findings.verification: Absent denominators remain missing; scientific gate NO-GO.
findings.remaining_risk: Natural-image efficacy and training-induced security behavior untested.

findings.title: Within-batch duplicate freshness gap
findings.root_cause: Previous IDs were added to consumed only after a complete update.
findings.fix_attempted: Added non-mutating per-batch ID validation before model/gradient work; archived old source.
findings.verification: Prepatch duplicate accepted;5 regression tests PASS including real trainer early rejection.
findings.remaining_risk: Distinct trajectories for the same condition remain explicitly permitted; no historical duplicate was inferred.
